observations: Reviewed all 15 values against English, context and live call sites. Одобрения is approval, not confirmation; Агент/Команда/Навык match the tabs. The operation badges preserve the proposal state, Устарело indicates stale status, and the product-update note says how to regain skill review.

Проверить is an infinitive, not an approval command. The create labels use the cases required by создать; update labels use the cases required by для. Показать все/Свернуть describe the two list states, and the tooltip carries both facts.
